> Flooring Maxx is a locally owned and operated certified Mohawk dealer serving Toledo, Ohio and the surrounding area. They specialize in Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank flooring, backed by installers with at least 10 years of industry experience. Their standout value proposition is a no-pressure, in-home showroom experience where they bring samples directly to the customer, combined with flexible financing options including 12 months no payments and no interest.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Flooring Maxx
Flooring Maxx is a locally owned and operated certified Mohawk dealer serving Toledo, Ohio and the surrounding area. They specialize in Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank flooring, backed by installers with at least 10 years of industry experience. Their standout value proposition is a no-pressure, in-home showroom experience where they bring samples directly to the customer, combined with flexible financing options including 12 months no payments and no interest.

## Services/Products
- Revwood laminate flooring installation
- SolidTech vinyl plank flooring installation
- No-pressure in-home estimates
- 12 months no payments / no interest financing
- Low monthly payment options

## Target Audience
- Homeowners in Toledo, Ohio and surrounding areas
- Toledo Homeowners
- First-time Homebuyers
- Home Renovators
